args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (banker's rounding) per FIN-212

The implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP despite the docstring specifying
banker's rounding. Tests in tests/test_money.py (e.g. 2.665 -> 2.66)
expect ROUND_HALF_EVEN, causing the nightly build to fail.

args.head: fix/FIN-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
- Nightly build failed because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (e.g. `2.665 -> 2.66`) per FIN-212, but `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP`.
- Changed `round_money` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in line with its docstring and the tests.

## Testing
- CI run on commit `08d3cd5986` passed.
